I bought the Vault Edition at launch and enjoyed the game when it first released. Recent official patches have introduced game-breaking bugs that ruin the multiplayer experience.

1. Killstreak loadout bug: Changes made to killstreaks in the menu do not apply in matches. The game locks me to a fixed set of killstreaks, removing tactical customization, a core part of multiplayer.
2. Saved loadouts wiped: After changing one single perk, all my custom saved weapon loadouts were permanently deleted. My old loadouts from COD20 are still intact after years, confirming this is a new save file bug introduced by updates.

I have restarted the game and verified game files, the bugs persist. I paid extra for the Vault Edition, only to have official updates break core features and erase my saved loadouts. The multiplayer is no longer playable. Extremely disappointed.

After spending over 100 hours in BO7, I can confidently say this is a very strong entry in the series and incredibly fun to play.

The Multiplayer is fast, responsive, and highly addictive. The map design is solid, gunplay feels great, and the progression system always gives you something to work toward.

The Zombies mode is excellent. It offers a lot of content, great replayability, and feels both challenging and rewarding, whether you’re playing solo or with friends.

The Endgame content is also very well done.

That said, I have to be honest: the story/campaign is the weakest in the entire series. It’s not very engaging and feels forgettable compared to previous titles.

Despite that, the strengths of the game far outweigh its weaknesses. If you’re looking for great multiplayer, an awesome Zombies experience, and plenty to do in the endgame, BO7 is absolutely worth your time.
